# Overview {.unnumbered}

These labs give practical experience with machine learning (ML) systems on a compact, high-end embedded device, the Seeed Studio Grove Vision AI V2. Unlike large models that require data center-scale resources, these labs let you work directly with hardware and software using TinyML. This approach gives a tangible understanding of the challenges of deploying AI, albeit on a small scale. The principles are the same as those you would meet in larger or even smaller systems.

The Grove Vision AI V2 sits between basic microcontroller solutions, such as the Seeed XIAO ESP32S3 Sense or Arduino Nicla Vision, and more powerful single-board computers, like the Raspberry Pi. At its heart lies the Himax WiseEye2 HX6538 processor, featuring a **dual-core Arm Cortex-M55 and an integrated ARM Ethos-U55 neural network unit**.

The Arm Ethos-U55 is a microNPU, a processor designed to accelerate ML inference in area-constrained embedded and IoT devices. Paired with the Cortex-M55 processor, it delivers a 480$\times$ uplift in ML performance over existing Cortex-M-based systems. The board operates at 400 MHz with configurable internal system memory (SRAM) up to 2.4 MB, which supports computer vision workloads while keeping the power draw and form factor that edge applications require.

This position makes it a suitable platform for learning advanced TinyML concepts. It has the simplicity and low power requirements of smaller systems, with capabilities well beyond those of traditional microcontroller-based solutions.

![Grove - Vision AI Module V2. Source: SEEED Studio.](./images/jpeg/grove_vision_ai_v2.jpeg){width=65% fig-align="center"}

## Where to Buy {#sec-overview-where-to-buy}

The Grove Vision AI V2 is available from Seeed Studio:

- [Grove Vision AI V2 (Seeed Studio)](https://www.seeedstudio.com/Grove-Vision-AI-Module-V2-p-5851.html) (~$25)

You will also need a compatible camera module (Raspberry Pi OV5647) and optionally a master controller like the XIAO ESP32S3.

## Pre-requisites {#sec-overview-prerequisites-7b1e}

- **Grove Vision AI V2 Board**: Ensure you have the Grove Vision AI V2 Board.
- **Raspberry Pi OV5647 Camera Module**: The camera should be connected to the Grove Vision AI V2 Board for image capture.
- **Master Controller**: Can be a Seeed XIAO ESP32S3, a XIAO ESP32C6, or other devices.
- **USB-C Cable**: This is for connecting the board to your computer.
- **Network**: With internet access for downloading the necessary software.
- **XIAO Expansion Board Base**: This helps connect the Master Device to the Physical World (optional).
